comments.html: Science is the art of asking questions.

comments.author: Mstthew Putman
comments.html: I face this question myself everyday working in a space with artists and scientists. Sometimes I want our scientists to be artistic, and often times I want artists to see the world in a scientific way. I think Science is how we understand the universe, math is a tool and possibly an explanation and art fills those gaps that makes being human so exciting. Ed Frenkel and I discuss it here, where we touch on mathematical beauty, physical reality and art. http://math.berkeley.edu/~frenkel/intercourse-mag.pdf
